description: This file defines a base class for unit testing the WebAudioPlayer component, including setup, teardown, and various helper methods for testing buffer management, timer behavior, and interactions with mocks.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for unit testing WebAudioPlayer functionality.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects and configuration parameters.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Sets up and creates an instance of WebAudioPlayerServerInternal with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the WebAudioPlayer instance, unmapping resources.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task on the main thread.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task and waiting on the main thread.

methods.name: getBufferAvailableSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of buffer availability and shared memory info.

methods.name: writeBufferSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful writing of buffer data.

methods.name: expectWriteStoredFrames
methods.description: Sets expectation for writing stored frames, calculating buffer pointers and lengths.

methods.name: expectWriteNewFrames
methods.description: Sets expectation for writing new frames, handling buffer wrap-around.

methods.name: expectStartTimer
methods.description: Sets expectation for creating and starting a timer.

methods.name: expectCancelTimer
methods.description: Sets expectation for cancelling an active timer.
